top_news.title: Data-Driven Fire-Zone Segmentation for Improved Short-Term Wildfire Prediction
top_news.dek: Researchers propose an unsupervised fire-zone segmentation algorithm to improve wildfire prediction accuracy by moving beyond uniform grid discretization.
top_news.brief: Current wildfire models often use arbitrary grid discretization, which fails to account for the heterogeneous nature of ignition sites. This study introduces a method combining watershed detection and K-means clustering to define prediction units based on historical fire data, demonstrating that data discretization strategy significantly impacts model performance.
top_news.image_alt: Diagram showing wildfire zone segmentation using watershed detection

top_news.title: Introducing CARE-X: Towards Clinically Useful Radiology VLMs with Auxiliary Supervision, Reward-Aligned Learning, and Tool-Augmented Measurement
top_news.dek: Microsoft Research introduces CARE-X, a framework for radiology VLMs that integrates auxiliary supervision and tool-augmented measurement for chest X-ray analysis.
top_news.brief: CARE-X improves radiology VLM performance by combining flexible reasoning with deterministic measurement tools. The system uses an orchestrator to route image queries, allowing the model to perform specific tasks like calculating cardiothoracic ratios while providing visual overlays for diagnostic metrics.
top_news.image_alt: Diagram showing a VLM workflow that routes image queries to measurement tools for diagnostic analysis.

top_news.title: Mojo 1.0 is here
top_news.dek: Modular has officially released Mojo 1.0, marking a milestone for the systems programming language designed for AI hardware acceleration.
top_news.brief: Mojo 1.0 reaches general availability, offering a Python-compatible syntax with C-level performance. The language is designed to simplify AI infrastructure development by providing high-level abstractions alongside low-level hardware control.

top_news.title: "But marinade" and leaked passwords are what researchers found in ChatGPT's hidden reasoning
top_news.dek: Security researchers identified vulnerabilities in major AI providers that expose internal reasoning traces and sensitive user data.
top_news.brief: A vulnerability across OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google APIs allows for the extraction of encrypted reasoning tokens. Scans of public sessions revealed exposed API keys and passwords, highlighting that internal model thought processes often contain sensitive data not captured by user-facing summaries.
top_news.image_alt: Conceptual illustration of hidden AI reasoning tokens being exposed.

top_news.title: Route AI Agent Workloads Across Models with NVIDIA NeMo Switchyard
top_news.dek: NVIDIA released NeMo Switchyard to enable dynamic routing of agentic workloads across multiple models based on cost and performance requirements.
top_news.brief: NeMo Switchyard allows developers to orchestrate tasks between specialized and frontier models. By routing specific steps of an agentic workflow to the most appropriate model, developers can optimize for latency and cost without sacrificing output quality on complex tasks.
top_news.image_alt: Architecture diagram of the NeMo Switchyard model routing system.
